text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Now rounding the fourth corner and 
entering the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It's Lucky Lilac! Lucky Lilac is in the 
lead!! Lucky Lilac crosses the line!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(————Hell yeahhh!! I did it, I did it, I 
did ittt!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I won a GⅠ!! I really won!! Aaaagh, 
yes!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Did ya all see that!? Ain't I amazing, 
ain't I amazing!? Keep your eyes on me 
just like this, ya hear!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Lucky Lilac is sooo strong...! And to be 
that composed right after winning...!! She 
already has the presence of a queen!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
So cool...! I really hope she takes the 
Triple Tiara...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Amazing—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad I came to watch. It helped me 
realize it all over again.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I want to win against you...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Afterward, during the winner's interview.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your victory today! 
Could you tell us how you're feeling right 
now...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Everything I've built up for today has 
borne fruit, and I couldn't be happier.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Using this victory as stepping stone, I 
will continue to do my utmost to run as an 
Umamusume worthy of the title of Queen."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer B
text_block_list.text:
"Will you be taking on the Triple Tiara in 
your Classic Year after all?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, got a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I immediately understood what she was 
confirming. So I gave a firm nod, offering 
my backing to her words.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......I, Lucky Lilac—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I shall go to claim the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
First, at the Oka Sho, allow me to show 
you how a lilac blooms.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Please, look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
――Ah. Look at this. The interview has 
already been made into an article.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Triple Tiara Declaration Issued! 
Expectations Rise for the New Queen's 
Success"—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...It's finally startin' to feel real. 
That I really became the Junior-class 
Queen.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...I'm still in the Junior Class. But a 
queen is a queen! Right now, I'm the star 
of the Junior Class Umamusume—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list:
Yo, Queen! You've got quite the grin on 
your face!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Why are you acting like an Edo native?! 
It's embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Still, well... I really am happy, 
honestly.
choice_data_list:
You're going to be the center of attention 
from now on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the top contender in the Classic 
campaign, the eyes of race fans will 
inevitably be fixed on her.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Attracting attention is just what I want. 
After all, that too is essential for a 
true star.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Let's keep giving it our all starting 
next spring as well.
choice_data_list:
I'll definitely make you the queen even in 
our Classic year!

I will absolutely make you the queen even 
in our Classic year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having won the Hanshin JF, she 
marked a glorious first step as a queen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Well then. Before Trainer gets here, 
maybe I'll do a light warmup lap—)
Lala!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Huge congratulations on the Hanshin JF 
the other day! That was an amazing 
run...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well... thank you kindly. I appreciate you 
going out of your way.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll aim for the Oka Sho too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I'll reach it, without fail. And then, 
I'm going to beat you!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Heh... That does sound exciting. But—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"There are folks out there expectin' me to 
bloom into a real star, too."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I can't just go and hand over the victory 
that easily, either."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's why... as the queen, I intend to 
accept the challenge with everything I've 
got.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho was still a long way off. And 
yet, sparks were undeniably flying.
